digest.component_or_area: jira-sync external test harness — multi-project rehearsal
propositions: Live-Cloud draft against REB+DIG projects failed at inbound fetch because non-existent mapped project keys (REBEMPTY) caused real Jira to parse-error, aborting the entire pass due to missing per-project try/except in fetcher._build_snapshot.
Stateful fake transport masked this failure by returning empty for unknown projects instead of erroring, making it impossible to validate fail-closed behavior on non-existent project keys.
Only two real Cloud projects available cannot model three distinct repo configurations, empty projects, and unknown-project failure paths simultaneously without cross-contamination.

Rehearsal must run against ephemeral Jira DC instance with dynamically provisioned throwaway projects (random RBJ-prefixed keys), torn down on every exit, to model genuine cross-project isolation and reproduce real JQL behavior.

Every mutating scenario must be preview-gated first (bridge preview asserts mutation targets exist only in intended project, empty intersection with all other configured projects) before bridge sync executes to prevent cross-project contamination.

Pass fails closed (write nothing) when a configured project key does not exist in Jira, and fails closed when an outbound update targets a project outside the configured scope, both verified through post-sync query assertions.
